payload.summary: Jim deferred the Actions deploy on 2026-08-25 after weighing it — parked on the roadmap at horizon next (node zasn46mk) rather than dropped. He is thinking about it; his stated reason for staying on the local branch deploy is that it costs no Actions minutes. Record for whoever picks it up: Actions minutes are free on public repos, so the actual trade is reproducibility (clean runner + bun install vs whatever is on this Mac) and an automatic trigger, against one interactive token refresh he has to run himself. Nothing is blocked meanwhile: the branch deploy works and the site is live, it just needs scripts/deploy-pages.sh run after each merge.
